market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $115 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: CME front-month settlement was $99.93 Apr 28; intraday hit $107. Settlement at/above $115 by June 30 needs further escalation, but EIA explicitly forecasts Brent peaking ~$115 in Q2 with WTI close behind. Hormuz disruption is the key driver.
